jobs.description:
Are you looking for an active and varied job in logistics? DHL Supply Chain in Beringe is looking for enthusiastic warehouse operators who are ready to roll up their sleeves. Whether you have experience with an EPT, OPT, reach truck, or forklift, we have various opportunities available within our modern distribution center.

Together with a dedicated team, you will ensure that all logistics processes run smoothly. No two days are the same. You will work with a variety of products, orders, and logistics activities, making your job both challenging and diverse. Experience is a plus, but it is certainly not required. With the right motivation, we are happy to teach you the rest.

Depending on your experience and preferences, your responsibilities may include:

- Picking orders using an EPT, OPT, forklift, and/or reach truck.
- Moving goods throughout the warehouse.
- Loading and unloading trucks.
- Operating a reach truck and/or forklift.
- Checking goods for quality and quantity.
- Preparing orders for shipment.
- Contributing to a safe, efficient, and well-organized warehouse environment.

You will work accurately, pay close attention to quality, and ensure that customers receive their orders on time.

Starting September 14, you will begin an extensive onboarding and training period on the work floor. From September 28 through October 16, you will therefore work the day shift from 08:00 to 17:00, allowing you to become familiar with all tasks and processes.

After the training period, you will work one of the following shifts:

- 08:00 - 17:00
- 11:00 - 20:00

You can choose to work a fixed shift or be available for both shifts. If you choose both, you will work on a weekly rotating schedule.

- Good command of Dutch and/or English.
- Experience in logistics.
- Proficiency in working with computer systems and Microsoft Excel.
- A flexible and motivated attitude.
- Own transportation.
- A valid EPT, OPT, and/or reach truck certificate is an advantag

As a logistic employee, you will work in a warehouse and start in the Value Added Services (VAS) department. Your tasks include checking goods, loading and unloading containers, and applying stickers to products. Together with your colleagues, you will ensure that all products are processed correctly.

This is a full-time position from Monday to Friday, working the day shift from 7:00 AM to 4:00 PM. On your first working day, you will work from 8:00 AM to 5:00 PM and be paired with a buddy who will guide you through all tasks and procedures. From your second day onwards, your regular working hours will be 7:00 AM to 4:00 PM.

After approximately two months, you will move to another logistics department within the warehouse. There, you will learn new tasks and gain more variety in your work.

During busy periods, you will work in a two-shift schedule:

- 6:00 AM – 3:00 PM
- 3:00 PM – 12:00 AM

This is a varied full-time position offering the opportunity to develop your skills and grow within the logistics sector.

- You have a good command of the English language, both spoken and written;
- You are available to work full-time;
- You are willing to start in a day shift and switch to a two-shift schedule after approximately two months;
- You have experience working in a production or logistics environment.

Warehouse Operator 
Vacancy ID: 4485 | Location: Waddinxveen, Logistics Centre Rotterdam, DACHSER Netherlands B.V. | Employment: Full-time | Contract: Fixed-term | Job category: Warehousing / Order Picking; Road Transport / Freight Forwarding 
As a Transit Terminal Operator, you will work in the cross-dock warehouse at DACHSER in Waddinxveen, part of our Logistics Centre Rotterdam in the Netherlands. Together with your colleagues, you make sure that goods are loaded, unloaded and processed safely, accurately and on time. 
You will work with an electric pallet truck (EPT) and a handheld scanner. As our logistics operation runs around the clock, you may work different shifts depending on the operation and your availability. 
"Together, we make sure every shipment leaves safely and on time." 
Your main tasks are: - Loading and unloading trailers and swap bodies. - Moving pallets with an electric pallet truck (EPT). - Scanning goods with a handheld scanner. - Placing goods in the correct location in the warehouse. - Checking whether goods are properly packed. - Reporting damage or other issues to your supervisor. 
Working hours 
You work 40 hours per week. You can work different shifts, depending on the operation and your availability. 
Possible shifts include: - Morning shift - Afternoon/evening shift - Night shift 
Together, we will look at which shift works best for you. 
Who are you? - You enjoy active and physical work. - You work well with colleagues. - You work safely and accurately. - You are flexible with working hours. - You speak Dutch or English. - You are available full-time. About DACHSER 
Logistics is People Business - this vision underlines the fact that our people are the driving force behind DACHSER's success. 
Founded in 1930, our family-owned company has grown into one of the world's leading logistics service providers. Through our global logistics network, we provide intelligent logistics solutions for our customers....

As a Warehouse Operator at Samsung SDS in Tilburg, you play a key role in ensuring a smooth and efficient logistics process. You will join a supportive and collaborative team where communication, flexibility, and teamwork are highly valued.

In this all-round position, you will work across multiple warehouse departments and, when required, at different Samsung SDS locations in Tilburg.  
Your responsibilities may include physically active tasks such as order picking, packing, and preparing shipments, as well as administrative duties like inspecting incoming goods, managing inventory, and processing data in warehouse management systems. This variety allows you to develop a broad range of skills while keeping your work challenging and engaging.

Flexibility is an important part of the role. You will primarily work in a two-shift schedule (morning and evening shifts), but during peak periods you may also be required to work night shifts and occasional Saturdays. 

Working hours range from 20 to 37.5 hours per week, offering flexibility while supporting the operational needs of the business.

Ready to become part of a global organization and contribute to efficient warehouse operations? We'd love to hear from you!

You enjoy staying active and thrive in an international working environment. You are reliable, flexible, and enjoy working as part of a team. You're comfortable adapting to different tasks, departments, and warehouse locations.

Requirements:

- You have your own transportation to travel to Tilburg.
- You have a good command of the English language.
- You are available to work full-time.
- You are physically fit and able to perform warehouse activities.
- You are flexible and willing to work in a three-shift schedule, including evening shifts, night shifts when required, and occasional Saturdays.
- You are a team player with a proactive attitude.
- You are willing to work across multiple departments and warehouse locations.

jobs.occupation: Order Picker at AS Watson in Heteren (Arnhem) (113871003)
jobs.description:
As an order picker at AS Watson in Heteren, you’re always on the move. You collect products using a voice pick system: your headset tells you where to go, you grab the right product, and confirm it. You walk a lot, lift small and large packages, and make sure everything ends up in the right place. You work in a 2- or 3-shift system, depending on your preference. This means sometimes you start early, sometimes later, but you always have time for yourself. In this role as warehouse worker or logistics employee, you really make an impact: thanks to you, thousands of people can shop daily at Kruidvat, Trekpleister, and ICI Paris XL.

- You speak Dutch or English
- You can handle physical work
- You’re available to work at least one Saturday every four weeks
- You choose either a 2- or 3-shift system
- You live a maximum of 30 km from Heteren

Looking for an active part-time job in the evening?

As a Logistics Associate at DHL, you will work together with your colleagues to ensure a smooth sorting process. You will process packages so they can reach their destination on time.

You can start as a Loader, where you place packages onto the conveyor belt, or as an Unloader, where you remove sorted packages from the conveyor belt and place them in a cart. As you gain more experience, you will have the opportunity to perform a variety of tasks within the sorting center.

You will work the evening shift, which starts between 4:30 PM and 5:30 PM and ends at 1:00 AM.

Packages can weigh up to 25 kg. If a package is heavier, you will always lift it together with a colleague.

- You are available 2 or 3 days per week, on Monday, Tuesday and/or Wednesday
- You speak Dutch or English
- You are at least 18 years old
- You live in or around Zwolle, Meppel or Kampen
- You have your own transportation (car, bicycle or scooter) or live within walking distance of the sorting center
- You are able to lift packages weighing up to 25 kg

Our client is a procurement-focused consultancy company supporting organisations on procurement projects and strategic sourcing challenges. They are currently looking for a Team Lead & Sustainable Procurement Advisor to join their team in Rotterdam . 
In this role, you will combine a leadership position with hands-on advisory work. You will guide a team of consultants while working directly with clients on sustainability and circular procurement initiatives, with a strong focus on strategy, stakeholder engagement and implementation. 
Job Profile forTeam Lead & Sustainable Procurement Advisor 
Responsibilities will include but not be limited to: 
Your role will be to guide organisations towards a more circular and inclusive economic approach, balancing advisory work and team lead responsibilities at approximately 70/30. 
You will support in translating future ambitions into concrete and achievable projects, including: - Develop and implement sustainable and circular objectives - Engage employees across the organisation - Establish collaborations and value chain initiatives - Embed sustainability within procurement processes - Measure ...

What will you do?

As a TIG Welder, you will work closely with a small and experienced team to build high-quality stainless steel filter systems.

Your responsibilities include:

- TIG welding of stainless steel components (RVS/INOX)
- Assembling parts based on technical drawings
- Welding both precision components and larger constructions
- Checking dimensions and product quality
- Contributing ideas for technical improvements and solutions
- Helping build complete filtration systems from start to finish

- Experience as a TIG Welder
- Experience with stainless steel (preferred)
- Ability to read technical drawings
- Good communication skills in English, German, or Dutch
- Eye for detail and quality
- Motivated and reliable attitude

Looking for a stable full-time job with a good salary and great benefits?

Then this could be the job for you!

We are looking for motivated Warehouse Workers to join the DHL Supply Chain team in Weert. No long experience needed – you will receive training on the job and have plenty of opportunities to learn and grow.

Full-time availability – You are available to work 40 hours per week. Dayshift & 2-shifts available.

Own transportation – You can travel to and from the workplace independently.

English skills – You can communicate in English at work.

Reliable and motivated – You are dependable, willing to work hard and enjoy working in team.

Are you highly skilled in Excel, administratively strong, and able to maintain an overview in complex processes? Do you work accurately and enjoy keeping logistics operations running smoothly in a dynamic environment? Then this position at Samsung SDS in Tilburg could be the perfect opportunity for you. You will work in an international environment where your analytical mindset and structured approach make a real difference. Through Olympia, you will join Samsung SDS in a long-term position.

In this role, you will not be responsible for planning trucks from point A to point B. Instead, you will ensure that the inbound transportation process runs smoothly by monitoring and managing it through various systems. You will track progress, identify discrepancies, and process data accurately.

Your responsibilities include:

- Monitoring and following up on inbound transportation flows (rail and ocean freight) through internal systems
- Checking, analyzing, and processing transportation and planning data
- Identifying delays or irregularities and coordinating with the relevant stakeholders
- Recording transportation data accurately in internal systems (such as FIS)
- Working with Excel reports and data overviews
- Contributing ideas to improve processes and working methods

You will work full-time in a day shift and become part of a close-knit team of experienced colleagues who will provide thorough training and support.

You are analytical, detail-oriented, and comfortable working in an administrative role where systems and data play a central role. You think ahead, work in a structured manner, and are confident taking responsibility.

You also have:

- A minimum MBO Level 4 working and thinking level (or equivalent vocational qualification)
- Strong administrative and digital skills
- Experience with Microsoft Excel
- Good command of the English language
- Availability to work 40 hours per week

Preferred (not required):

Are you an experienced logistics leader who enjoys optimizing operations and developing teams? Do you know how to combine operational excellence with strategic thinking? Then we are looking for you!

As a Warehouse Manager, you are responsible for the overall warehouse operation. You lead Supervisors and Team Leaders, ensure that productivity and quality targets are achieved, and continuously improve processes to deliver the best possible service to customers.

What will you do?
As a Warehouse Manager, you oversee the daily warehouse operation and manage multiple teams through Supervisors and Team Leaders.

Your responsibilities include:

- Managing the overall warehouse operation, including inbound, storage, order picking, and outbound processes
- Leading, coaching, and developing Supervisors and Team Leaders
- Monitoring KPIs, productivity, quality, and operational performance
- Ensuring efficient workforce planning and optimal staffing levels
- Driving continuous improvement projects and implementing new processes
- Working closely with Operations, Customer Service, Planning, and customers
- Preparing management reports and analysing operational performance
- Ensuring compliance with safety, quality, and company standards

You are an experienced people manager who enjoys building high-performing teams while continuously improving operational processes.

You also have:

- A completed Bachelor's degree (HBO), preferably in Logistics or Supply Chain Management
- At least 3 years of management experience within logistics or manufacturing
- Strong leadership and coaching skills
- Experience with KPI management and continuous improvement
- Excellent communication skills in Dutch and English
- Strong analytical and organizational skills
- You have your own accommodation
- A valid Certificate of Conduct (VOG). If your VOG is approved, Olympia will reimburse the cost of €41.35. If your VOG is not approved, the cost will be at your own expense

As a logistics employee in the Eemshaven, you’ll ensure that everything runs smoothly in the data centre. You’ll be working in a modern data centre for a major American client.

In this role, you’ll be responsible for a range of tasks: you’ll be loading and unloading heavy goods, which can sometimes be quite a challenge. But don’t worry, you’ll be working alongside great colleagues who’ll lend a hand when needed. You will also check materials and move them to the correct location, where your eye for detail will come in handy. Furthermore, you will be responsible for assembling and partially installing various racks within the data centre and assisting with other logistics processes. Together with the team, you will ensure that everything runs smoothly in the data centre. 

You will work in two shifts, and working days are mainly Monday to Friday, but you may also be asked to help out at weekends to support your colleagues.This is a long-term role (expected to last at least one year) and there is also the possibility of being taken on by the client on a permanent contract.

Are you looking for a long-term role with opportunities for progression? Apply now!

You’re someone who likes to get stuck in and enjoys a hands-on job. You enjoy working in a warehouse and making sure everything runs smoothly.

What you bring to the role:

- You’re fit and strong enough to lift and move heavy items. This ensures everything ends up in the right place.
- You have a proficient level of Dutch and/or English. This is important for working well with your colleagues and following the rules and regulations.
- You have a driving licence and your own transport.
- You can apply for a Certificate of Good Conduct (VOG).
- You are willing to obtain your VCA certificate.

As a CNC woodworker, you will operate our woodworking machines to produce premium items from different types of wood. Your responsibilities include setting up machines, loading materials, performing quality inspections, and maintaining a safe and efficient work environment.

- Minimum of 1 year CNC experience
- Comfortable working in a 2-shift schedule
- Good English communication skills
